known_fact_audit.criterion: Primary target and secondary attacks in every other Company region with unrest
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: triggers secondary Rebellions in every other Company region with unrest

known_fact_audit.criterion: Primary first; Bombay then Madras then Bengal; Commander orders associated regions
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: primary Crisis first, then secondary regions in Bombay → Madras → Bengal Army order; within each Presidency, its Commander chooses the order of associated regions

known_fact_audit.criterion: Normal primary attack is ordinary Invasion/Rebellion strength plus target unrest
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: Primary normal Crisis strength is normal Invasion/Rebellion strength plus unrest in the target

known_fact_audit.criterion: Secondary strength only its local unrest, without modifier or empire strength
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: every secondary Rebellion uses only the unrest cubes in that secondary region, with no event modifier or empire strength

known_fact_audit.criterion: Associated Commander chooses/exhausts; Military Affairs acts if vacant; Chairman if both vacant; substitutes gain/lose no trophies
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: If Commander is vacant, Military Affairs acts in the Commander’s stead and gains/loses no trophies; if both are vacant, Chairman chooses and gains/loses no trophies

known_fact_audit.criterion: Compulsory active Army exhaustion equal to Crisis strength or as many as possible; alliance once and not split among purposes
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: Exhaust active Army pieces equal to Crisis strength, or as many as possible; local alliance strength is usable once and cannot be split among purposes

known_fact_audit.criterion: Printed equality means attack fails/defense succeeds; all local unrest removed; actual Commander gains one trophy; substitutes none
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: If newly exhausted pieces equal Crisis strength, the attack fails and defense succeeds: remove all unrest in the attacked region; actual Commander gains one trophy (substitute gains/loses none)

known_fact_audit.criterion: A failed normal primary Invasion also loses an attacker tower if possible
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: if it defeated a normal primary Invasion also remove one attacker tower if possible

known_fact_audit.criterion: Printed non-equality means attack succeeds/defense fails and Region Loss
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: If strength does not equal, the attack succeeds and defense fails, causing Region Loss

known_fact_audit.criterion: Excess alliance counting is unresolved, without asserting a >= survival ruling
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: including strength 2 versus a strength 1 attack
